title: History, correction and deletion
brief: Represent agreements, corrections and deletion without confusing today’s state with history.
outcomes: Distinguish effective time from recorded time
Trace a correction or deletion through dependent and external records
entry: Keys, references, agreed prices and typed time.

title: Updates, upserts and bulk imports
brief: Make each change conditional and each imported conflict a domain decision.
outcomes: Use affected rows to enforce a write precondition
Stage, validate and reconcile a replayable batch
entry: Keys, constraints, transaction atomicity and the mug update.

neighbours.RL93: Owns request identity after ambiguous commit.

title: SQL at the application boundary
brief: Keep query meaning and transaction ownership intact across the application connection.
outcomes: Handle one request’s connection, result, error and cancellation coherently

title: Indexes and access paths
brief: Understand which work an index saves and what every maintained entry costs.
outcomes: Derive useful key order and selectivity from a query
Weigh read savings against writes, space and upkeep
entry: Keys, result semantics and ordered queries.

title: Query execution and bad plans
brief: Locate the operator and estimate that turn a valid query into excessive work.

title: Locks, contention and deadlocks

title: Outboxes and database-backed jobs
